title: System health at a glance
summary: HQ teams can check the portal’s services after a deployment and identify what needs attention.

changes.title: Check the portal after a deployment
changes.body: Open System Health to review the API, database, background notification queue, file storage, push, email, backups and running app version. Each check explains its result and next step. Refresh the checks or download a report. Offline or outdated results are clearly marked; diagnostics do not send test messages.

title: Safer offline work and easier form setup
summary: Keep field work safely queued, review corrections, find industry partners and prepare learner CSV uploads.

changes.title: More reliable offline sync
changes.body: New actions stay saved when sync is running. Drafts are shown only for your account. Failed security checks allow another sync attempt, and actions needing review wait for your correction. Reviewing an edit keeps its original record; saving the correction replaces the old queued action. Repeat attempts use a saved acknowledgement to prevent duplicate writes. If a result is uncertain, check the server record before submitting again.

changes.title: Resume recent field work offline
changes.body: Institution officers and partner users can reopen a recent session offline for up to 24 hours and use learner choices loaded previously on the same browser. Saved work is checked against your current access when it reaches the server. Older queued actions require review before they can be submitted safely.

changes.title: Industry partner search and learner upload template
changes.body: Search partners by name, region or location in the placement form and the industry partner user form. On the learner registry, Download CSV Template provides the accepted columns for bulk uploads. Upload guidance explains dates, required values and preserving leading zeros.

title: A clearer cohort comparison
summary: Compare intake years in one table, open the learners who need follow-up, and export the counts you see.

changes.title: Simple intake-year comparison
changes.body: Cohort Comparison now shows learners, currently enrolled, graduated and need attention in a compact table, with matching cards on phones. View learners opens the selected intake. The attention count opens the exact learners counted, with readable follow-up reasons. One Export button downloads the displayed comparison.

changes.title: Reliable intake groups and follow-up counts
changes.body: Records without an intake year now appear together under Intake year missing. Cohort totals stay visible when opening a follow-up list. New placements are no longer flagged simply because they have just started; monitoring follows the configured visit interval, and assessment follow-up uses the percentage score scale.

title: More complete National learner oversight
summary: Find learner records, placements and attendance directly, with a new workspace for learner progress and outcomes.

changes.title: A Learner Oversight workspace for HQ
changes.body: Open Learner Oversight in the HQ Action Centre to review academic stages, intake cohorts, learner risk, attendance compliance, monitoring quality, assessments and employer feedback. Select a cohort or risk queue to investigate.

changes.title: Direct access to learner operations
changes.body: The National menu now includes Learner Register, Learner Risk & Progress, Placements and Attendance Logs. HQ Managers and HQ Staff can open learner progress within their assigned scope.

changes.title: Report approval stages now show their totals
changes.body: National and Regional dashboards now show report counts for Draft, Certified, Generated, Submitted, Regional approved, HQ approved and Rejected stages. Select a stage to open its reports.

title: Clearer learner deletion buttons
summary: Learner deletion buttons now remain easy to see before and after selecting learners.

changes.title: Visible delete controls
changes.body: Delete selected now uses readable red text on a pale red background until learners are selected, then changes to a solid red button. The deletion confirmation button is also clearly visible.

title: Learner deletion is easier to find
summary: Delete selected is now beside the Learner Register heading and available to SuperAdmins.

changes.title: Find Delete selected at the top of the registry
changes.body: SuperAdmins and institution teams can now find Delete selected beside the Learner Register heading. Select learners to enable it. SuperAdmins can clean up selected records across institutions; linked placement and learning records remain protected.

title: Delete selected learner records together
summary: Clean up the learner registry with a clear selection, confirmation, and result summary.

changes.title: Bulk delete from the learner registry
changes.body: Institution teams can select individual learners or the current page, choose Delete selected, and review the names before confirming. Learners with linked placement, learning, support, or guardian records are kept. The result shows how many records were deleted and why others were kept. Bulk deletion requires an online connection.

title: Safer account changes and clearer reassignment
summary: Resolve assigned work before removing access, and keep account changes consistent.

changes.title: Review assigned work before changing access
changes.body: Before suspending, deleting, or changing an account’s role or scope, administrators must resolve its assigned learners, active placements, and open support work. Monitoring delegations now appear in the workload review. Release a delegation so the originating institution can assign a replacement, then retry suspension or deletion.

changes.title: Account changes preserve administrator access
changes.body: An administrator cannot delete, suspend, or change the role of their own account. At least one active SuperAdmin must remain. HQ can mark an approved access request as implemented only when the selected account matches the approved role and scope.

changes.title: Clearer password setup and sign-in protection
changes.body: Accounts that need password setup must finish it before using the portal. If an administrator changes your access, sign in again to continue. Reactivating a suspended account requires a fresh sign-in.

title: Portal updates and alerts for families
summary: Explore what’s new and keep up with your ward’s workplace learning.

changes.title: Stay informed about your ward’s progress
changes.body: Guardians linked to a learner now receive an alert when a workplace placement is activated, a monitoring visit is logged, or a competency assessment is recorded. Each alert names the learner and opens your family overview. Alerts follow your notification preferences in Settings.

changes.title: A home for portal updates
changes.body: Open What’s new from the menu or your profile menu to read release notes at any time. Choose For my role to see updates relevant to your work, or All updates to explore everything.

changes.title: A gentle reminder after a new release
changes.body: A notice lets you know when new release notes are available. Read them or dismiss the notice when you’re ready. It won’t interrupt your work, and the full history remains available.

title: Clearer partner approvals and easier corrections
summary: Partner submissions are easier to review, correct, and send back to HQ.

changes.title: Correct a rejected partner submission
changes.body: The submitting institution’s Admin or Manager can read the HQ rejection reason, choose Correct and resubmit, update the partner details, and send the submission back for HQ approval. Staff can ask their institution’s Admin or Manager to make the correction.

changes.title: Explain why a submission was rejected
changes.body: HQ reviewers must provide a rejection reason so the submitting team knows what to correct. If another reviewer has already decided or the submission has changed, refresh and review the latest details before continuing.

changes.title: Send regional corrections to HQ
changes.body: For an approved partner, choose Request changes instead of editing the shared record directly. Current approved details remain available until HQ accepts the correction. Regional submitters can also correct and resubmit their own rejected registrations.

changes.title: Approval decisions stay consistent
changes.body: Competing or repeated HQ decisions can no longer overwrite each other. Earlier decisions remain in the audit history when a rejected submission is corrected and reviewed again.
